name: Covarion.GTR
title: Covarion model with general reversible switching

args.name: method
args.description: `AlwaysSwitch` keeps the supplied switching rates; `MetropolisSwitching` can preserve component and character frequencies by reducing switching rates.

description: Switches between mixture components using a general reversible switching matrix. The switching methods coincide when component equilibrium frequencies are equal. With different frequencies, `AlwaysSwitch` can require a rooted tree even when the input models are reversible.
